Similarly, for Atom 0, I gave partial credit (0.5) rather than 0.0 because the user likely perceives the hybrid as a 'cow' in a loose sense, even if taxonomically incorrect.

I did not override any negative verdicts to positive without visual proof; in fact, I confirmed the negatives via the detector evidence (4 cats detected).
